author: adeyumii
content:
Okay so Atzi is a black based girl, so she has two black genes. She also has at least one dilution gene (that makes her colors washed out, making her grey!) and one dense gene (meaning not diluted). She has at least one stripe gene

Itzel got the black genetic from mom since Mom only HAS black. She is a tortie though, so her orange must come from dad. I'm staring at Glock at this point. She has no stripe genes (acceptable if Glock is also no stripes)

Temiquini though
If boy: Y chromosome from dad, Black gene from mom. Stripe gene from mom for sure with unknown recessive (could be homozygote)

If girl: Black from mom, black from dad. Stripe gene from mom. Paquini is dad

author: adeyumii
content: If Temiquini is a girl then their dad HAS to be paquini or some other black or gray male cat. If Temiquini is a boy then ... Shrug

author: adeyumii
content: Colors being tied to X sex chromosomes makes things a bit easier when determining parentage lowk
